adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the booking query includes `user: { include: { destinationCalendar: true, credentials: true } }`, but `booking.user.credentials` is never referenced afterward. Credentials are instead fetched via `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)`. This makes the `credentials: true` include an unnecessary over-fetch of sensitive credential rows into memory and adds avoidable I/O, even if not directly leaked by the code shown.
